article.title: VidantaWorld Mexico Open 2026: Model Ranks Lipsky, Yellamaraju, Putnam Ahead of Power Rankings
article.dek: Tournament model places three players inside the top three despite power ranks of 24, 19, and 39.
article.introduction: The Vidanta Vallarta model weights SG ATG at 6 percent and SG Total at 8 percent, elevating players who gain strokes around the green. David Lipsky, Sudarshan Yellamaraju, and Andrew Putnam occupy the top three tournament ranks while sitting 24th, 19th, and 39th in power rank.
